observed_failure: An exclusive read handle did not prevent a same-volume hard link. The child then failed reading that alias; the fixture incorrectly expected the wrapper's fallback-copy diagnostic before child execution.
fixture_revision: Create the required library on the runner's system volume. First require a real os.link attempt to fail with Windows error 17 (ERROR_NOT_SAME_DEVICE), then hold an exclusive handle and require the original copy-error diagnostic. A separate child-start marker must remain absent.

portable_validation.platform: macOS, real wrapper compiled with explicit windows cfg; not native Windows

manual_windows_scope: The existing Bazel workflow accepts a default-false windows_shard_one_only input. True runs the unchanged shard-1 commands, target selection, and 60-minute budget. The full Windows aggregate and other platform jobs are skipped, so this mode cannot qualify the complete matrix.
